item.title: Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai win Nobel Prize in chemistry
item.description: Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai won the Nobel Prize in chemistry Wednesday for their discovery of non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis.
item.content:encoded:
Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai won the Nobel Prize in chemistry Wednesday for their discovery of non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis.

(Image credit: Fredrik Sandberg)

item.title: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics has gone to a neutrino detector in Antarctica
item.description: The Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded Francis Halzen of the University of Wisconsin Madison, who built an observatory under Antarctica.

item.title: Vietnamese police arrest 12 suspected of prowling city streets at night, snatching cats for meat
item.description: State media cited investigators who said the network recruited people to ride motorcycles through neighborhoods at night, trapping up to 10 cats a night.

item.title: Francis Halzen wins Nobel Prize in physics for work on high-energy neutrinos from space
item.description: The 82-year-old scientist, originally from Belgium, is affiliated with the University of Wisconsin–Madison. His research into capturing neutrinos at the South Pole dates back to the 1980s.

item.title: Wildfire smoke affects animals in unique ways. Scientists are trying to understand it
item.description: The new field of "smoke ecology" examines how wildfire smoke perturbs wild places and animals — and what might be done to prevent its worst mayhem.

item.title: Nobel medicine prize goes to 3 scientists for research into brain activity
item.description: The Nobel Prize in medicine was awarded Monday to three scientists working on the mechanisms the brain uses to switch on, or off, the activity of individual nerve cells.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Just short of its 200th birthday, a landmark natural history museum shuts down
item.description: Beloved for its dinosaurs, Philadelphia's storied Academy of Natural Sciences closed down this week, amid an intense fight by local residents, politicians and scientists to save it.
